The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to achieve good performance in challenging real-world re-identification, it is necessary to model the structural aspects of the human figure.

, in order to achieve state-of-the-art results, the re-identification community should move away from appearance-based approaches and look at other discriminative cues, which are better suited for the task at-hand.
, in order to achieve good performance, a deep CNN needs to be able to understand the structural attributes of a human figure, which can be learned by training it on synthetic data.
